technology_name: A LINEAR SORTING TABLE WITH MANUALLY MOVABLE PALLETS
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Fully automated sensor-driven conveyor sorting networks are highly cost-prohibitive for small fulfillment operations, while basic static tables generate operational bottlenecks.
description: An ergonomic warehouse sortation framework comprising a structural linear table guide frame equipped with low-friction guide ways, manual multi-directional rolling pallets, mechanical pallet end-stoppers, and an integrated drop-through gravity return collection slot.
applications: Small-scale e-commerce fulfillment hubs, post-harvest agricultural sorting hubs, localized manufacturing parcel dispatch lines, and educational material-handling labs.
